name: otp-input
title: OTP input
description: Enter a one-time code, one digit per box, with paste support.
a11y: The boxes are a group with a name; each box is labelled "Digit N of M".
Typing moves forward, Backspace moves back, arrows move, pasting fills all boxes.
inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete="one-time-code" for mobile and autofill.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the group, for example "Verification code".

props.name: length
props.description: Number of boxes, which is the length of the code. Default 6.

props.name: value
props.description: The code typed so far when controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The code typed at first when uncontrolled. Default empty.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole code (so far) every time a character is added or removed.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once when every box is filled.

props.name: alphanumeric
props.description: Allow letters as well as digits.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. A hidden input submits the whole code.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the boxes as having an error: sets `aria-invalid` and shows the error border.
